rules.source_quote: aimed at providing assistance for advancement of Girls pursuing technical education
Family income from all sources should not be more than Rs. 8 lakh per annum during the current financial year
rules.note: Rs. 8 lakh = 800000; limit is inclusive ('not more than').

MISSING FIELD: failed or dropped out in a subsequent year (exclusion, PSGS-DIP-IN-EXCLUSION-01).
